auditWatchlist.observation: Physical writer workflows inspected set result reconciliation condition to steps.quota.outputs.physical_allowed == 'true' && success(). If a granted writer fails mid-write, no result-mode receipt is recorded, leaving the reservation outstanding until UTC reset. This is fail-conservative but not a complete per-run actual-write reconciliation; require bounded failure-path evidence or an audited mechanism.

Common action defaults requested_rows_read to zero and current reservation ledger sums outstanding requestedRowsWritten only. Current GraphQL rowsRead is observed, but proof of predicted/competing read-heavy workload headroom remains absent; do not claim the 5M/day read budget is fully collision-proof.

Independent static scope checked all 16 workflows sharing system2-isolated-d1-writer, not all 249 workflows in the repository; further audit should reject any other credentialed, physical System2 D1 mutation outside the registered authority group.

GraphQL grouped analytics returns observed account usage, but no independent bound on provider publication lag/interval was proven. For allowed write bursts preserve conservative headroom and evaluate actual post-write metadata before closing.
